fact: Ethio telecom said telebirr Remit receives remittances from nine countries (US, Canada, Israel, Saudi Arabia, UAE, UK, South Africa, Italy, Sweden) and Visa Direct allows transfers from over 190 countries.
title: Ethio telecom, in collaboration with Visa Inc., has launched the first wallet-based Virtual Visa Card in Ethiopia, as well as services that highly enhance remittance via Visa Direct and telebirr Remit services
